lanes.name: o-json-keys-config
lanes.scope: rows only: `!` → `jq.focus`; `x` → `value.delete`; `Z Z` → `viewer.save {quit}`; `Z Q` → `app.quit {force}`; `z a` → `ochazuke.outline.fold` on `shape`/`node`; `y y` → the existing yank verbs on `item`/`field`/`entry`/`line`/`shape`; `t` → `g t` for `node.array`/`node.object`; `hidden` on the node edit hints and plain-word hints on the reading rows; CHANGELOG
lanes.done_when: `bindings check` is clean; the footer golden shows the reading hints first
lanes.tests: `keys/bang-opens-jq`: `!` → title row `jq ▏`, query line focused; `keys/x-deletes`: `tab x` → `1 value edit` on the breadcrumb; `keys/za-folds`: `j z a` → the row's children hidden; `keys/g-t-array`: `g t` on a key → the node is `[]`, `t` on the edited tree does nothing; `keys/zz-writes-quits` (temp file); goldens `view-80/120`

lanes.name: o-json-ochazuke-v059

lanes.done_when: the o-json suite is green on v0.59

lanes.name: o-json-paste-asks
lanes.scope: `viewer.paste` asks with a document open; the empty document pastes at once
lanes.done_when: `p` on the original structure with a document asks; `n` keeps the document
lanes.tests: `doc/paste-asks-with-document`: `T p` → confirm "Replace the open document…?", `n` → same breadcrumb; `doc/empty-state` unchanged

lanes.name: o-json-next-kind
lanes.scope: `viewer.next-kind`/`previous-kind {kind}` over both structures in drawing order, opening folds; rows `] t [ t ] c [ c ] o [ o ] a [ a ] s [ s ] n [ n ] b [ b ] z [ z ] ? [ ? ] ] [ [` with `from: steps`
lanes.done_when: the owner's case takes `] t` from `.version` to `.nouns`; a count jumps N; at the last match it stays and says `no next table`
lanes.tests: `kind/next-table-from-scalar`: catalog fixture, cursor `.version`, `] t` → breadcrumb `.nouns (array …)`, data pane `Table .nouns`; `kind/previous-collection`; `kind/count-3`; `kind/opens-fold`: `z M ] s` → the fold opened on the string row; `kind/at-end-says`

lanes.name: ochazuke-outline-fold-all
lanes.scope: `ochazuke.outline.open-all`/`close-all` (view state, not undoable); rows `z R`/`z M` (and `z o`/`z c` → `expand`/`collapse`) in `bindings/tree.json`; UX-RULES R11 lines
lanes.done_when: the four keys work in the o-story outline; mtm's outline unchanged apart from the new keys; tagged
lanes.tests: `tree/close-all`: `z M` → only roots drawn; `tree/open-all`; `TestOutlineFoldAll`; o-json picks it up with its next bump

lanes.name: o-json-yank-parts
lanes.scope: `part: path\|key` on the yank verbs (one handler; concrete paths from `path.go`); `yank.path-style`; rows `y p`/`y k` on `item`/`field`/`entry`/`line`/`shape`/`node`; the `y p` hint
lanes.done_when: `y p` on a cell copies `.data[3].customer.email`, on a structure row `.data[].customer.email`; `"+y p` reaches the clipboard; `"a y p` fills register a
lanes.tests: `yank/path-of-cell`: `] t tab j j l l y p` → status `copied .data[2].customer`; `yank/path-structure`; `yank/path-pointer` (setting); `yank/register-a`; table test per noun

lanes.name: o-json-search
lanes.scope: `/` searches keys and values in both views with ochazuke's `Matcher` (`tab` cycles the mode), `n`/`N` in both views, `*`/`#` (`search-here`), `search.values`; the `/` row moves to search if question 1 is approved
lanes.done_when: `/refunded⏎` lands on a `.data[].status` row with that value; `n` steps; `tab` shows `fuzzy`; an invalid regex says why on the search line
lanes.tests: `search/value-match`: `/refunded ⏎` → breadcrumb `.data[].status`, data pane column highlighted; `search/n-edited-view`; `search/match-cycle`: `/ ref tab` → `fuzzy` tag; `search/star-key`; `search/regex-invalid-says-why`; `search/values-off`

lanes.name: o-json-descend
lanes.scope: `field.show`/`value.show` on a collection: the structure cursor moves to the path (a shape path), or the query line takes the concrete path (`jq.set`, under an array); `data.enter`; the detail stays on `#` and the palette
lanes.done_when: `enter` on `nouns` in `Fields .` shows `Table .nouns`; `h` in the structure goes back; `data.enter detail` is today
lanes.tests: `data/enter-shows-table`: catalog fixture, `tab`, move to `nouns`, `enter` → `Table .nouns`, structure cursor on `nouns`; `data/enter-under-array` → query line `.data[3].items`; `data/enter-detail-setting`

lanes.name: o-json-write-in-place
lanes.scope: `:w` with no name writes the source per `write.source`; `indent` parameter; `write.indent`, `write.sort-keys`; `Z Z` then writes in place
lanes.done_when: `:w⏎` on an edited file replaces it atomically (one confirm per question 2); `:w --indent 0` writes one line
depends: question 2; `o-json-key-order` before it is the default

lanes.name: o-json-key-order
lanes.scope: the tutorials plan's lane (the identity keeps document order per item)
lanes.done_when: an unedited `:w` writes what was read, modulo indentation

lanes.name: o-json-broken-excerpt + g F
lanes.scope: the tutorials plan's excerpt lane, plus `g F`: first try an `actions.json` row (document it in the README if it works), else `doc.edit {line, column}`
lanes.done_when: the data pane shows the line and a caret; `g F` opens `$EDITOR +3 FILE` (stub editor in the test)
lanes.tests: `doc/broken-excerpt`: open the trailing-comma fixture → excerpt with `^` under column 14; `doc/broken-g-F` (stub `$EDITOR` records its arguments); `doc/broken-excerpt-off`

lanes.name: o-json-sort-count
lanes.scope: `rows.sort {column, reverse}` as view state with the title arrow; `rows.count {column}` through `jq.set`; `restructure.sort-keys`; aliases `sort`, `sort!`, `count`; export writes the sorted order
lanes.done_when: `:sort!` on `total` orders the rows descending with `▼` in the title; `:count` on `status` shows `status · count` rows and the query in the query line
lanes.tests: `table/sort-reverse`: `] t tab` to `total`, `:sort! ⏎` → first row is the largest total; `table/count-status`; `structure/sort-keys-undo`: `:sort ⏎ u` → original order
